description: Yhdyskuntajätevesidirektiivin mukaiset jätevedenpuhdistamot is a dataset listed in Paikkatietohakemisto, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by paikkatiedot.ymparisto.fi. The Urban Waste Water Treatment Plants (UWWTD) dataset includes agglomerations, waste water treatment plants and their discharge points in accordance with the Urban Waste Water Treatment Directive (91/271/EEC). The Member States of the European Union report to the Commission on the implementation of the Urban Waste Water Treatment Directive (91/271/EEC). Coverage: FI. The portal shows the English title as "Urban wastewater treatment plants under the UWWTD" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Jätevesihuolto, INSPIRE-tietotuote. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2024-11-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-paikkatietohakemisto.
